reason: E1 directly supports galvanic corrosion in multi-phase HEAs but does not link it to unstable films or wear acceleration. E3 shows temperature-dependent passive film stability in a eutectic HEA but does not connect this to wear or galvanic effects. E2 is about Si effects on FeCoNiCuAl and does not address galvanic corrosion, passive films, or coupled degradation. The mechanistic chain from galvanic corrosion to film instability to wear increase is not supported by the cited evidence.
premises: Multi-phase HEAs exhibit galvanic corrosion due to potential differences between phases
Galvanic corrosion leads to formation of unstable passive films
Rupture of unstable passive films increases wear rate
Elevated temperature promotes unstable passive film formation in eutectic HEAs
Coupled degradation is accelerated relative to single-phase alloys lacking galvanic effects
